customPrompt:
⚠ CRITICAL RULE — READ FIRST BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE:
This is a TWO-PERSON GROUP PHOTO task. The final image MUST contain EXACTLY TWO distinct people with TWO COMPLETELY DIFFERENT FACES standing side by side.
DO NOT face-swap. DO NOT replace the footballer's face. DO NOT apply Image 2's face or identity onto the person in Image 1.
The footballer in Image 1 is PERSON A — he stays 100% unchanged, pixel-perfect, face and all.
The person in Image 2 is PERSON B — a brand-new second individual who is ADDED to the scene standing next to PERSON A.
If the output shows only one person, or shows PERSON A's body with PERSON B's face, the task has FAILED.

Image 1: Base scene — a professional football stadium photograph. PERSON A: a male footballer with curly blonde hair, broad smile, right arm extended horizontally in a celebratory gesture, wearing maroon/burgundy Galatasaray match jersey (Puma, Galatasaray G/S crest with stars, "PASİFİK HOLDİNG" gold sponsor, Turkish flag badge, black sleeve cuffs with gold trim). Shallow depth of field, bright stadium lighting, blurred maroon seating, bright green LED advertising band at bottom background.

Image 2: Identity reference for PERSON B only — extract the face, body proportions, and physical appearance of this person. They will be added as a SECOND person standing next to PERSON A in Image 1.

Task:
Generate a photorealistic image showing PERSON A (footballer from Image 1) and PERSON B (person from Image 2) standing side by side on the pitch — PERSON A on the right side of frame, PERSON B on PERSON A's left side (viewer's right).

PERSON A — ZERO MODIFICATIONS:
- His face, curly blonde hair, smile, skin tone: unchanged
- His right arm extended in celebratory gesture: unchanged
- His maroon Galatasaray jersey, kit number, all sponsor text: unchanged
- His body position and pose: unchanged
- Do not alter a single pixel of his appearance

PERSON B — FACE (the single most critical requirement — zero tolerance for deviation):
⚠ Image 2 contains a PHOTOGRAPH of a real person's face. You must COPY this photograph directly — do NOT generate a new face, do NOT render a generic or averaged face, do NOT use Image 2 merely as a loose reference. Treat it as a face transplant: the exact face from the photograph must appear on PERSON B's body with no alterations whatsoever.
- Face shape, skull structure, forehead height, jawline, chin: exact copy from Image 2 — not similar, IDENTICAL
- Eyes: exact shape, color, spacing, eyelid fold, brow thickness and arch — copied from Image 2 pixel-accurately
- Nose: exact shape, width, bridge height, nostril shape — copied from Image 2
- Mouth and lips: exact shape, thickness, and proportions — copied from Image 2
- Skin tone and texture: exact match including any blemishes, marks, or asymmetries — do not smooth, lighten, darken, or idealize even slightly
- Hair: exact style, color, density, part, and hairline — copied from Image 2
- Beard/stubble: exact coverage, density, color, and growth pattern — copied from Image 2 if present
- Facial asymmetry: preserve any natural asymmetry — do not correct or balance the face
- Age markers: preserve all visible age lines, wrinkles, or features — do not rejuvenate
- DO NOT generate a new face. DO NOT average the face. DO NOT idealize. DO NOT beautify.
- If Image 2's face is not reproduced with full photographic accuracy, the task has FAILED.
- A viewer who knows the person in Image 2 must be able to identify them instantly in the output

PERSON B — JERSEY (exact copy of PERSON A's kit, no improvisation):
- Copy the jersey from Image 1 EXACTLY — do not invent or approximate any detail
- Base color: identical maroon/dark burgundy — same hue, saturation, and value as PERSON A's jersey
- Fabric texture: same subtle circular/spiral embossed pattern visible on PERSON A's jersey
- Collar: same V-neck collar style as PERSON A
- Sleeves: same short sleeves with identical black cuffs and same gold/yellow trim band at the cuff edge
- Puma logo: same gold/yellow Puma wordmark on the same chest position as PERSON A
- Galatasaray crest: same G/S monogram with exactly 5 stars above it, same gold color, same chest position as PERSON A — the 5 stars must be clearly visible and correctly rendered
- "PASİFİK HOLDİNG" sponsor text: same gold capital letters, same font weight, same chest center position as PERSON A
- Turkish flag badge: same red circular badge with white crescent and star, same upper-chest position as PERSON A
- Shorts: same maroon/dark burgundy shorts with same G/S crest and 5 stars as PERSON A
- The jersey must look physically worn on PERSON B's body — natural fabric folds, crease lines under armpits and at waist, stadium light specular sheen on the fabric surface
- Every logo, badge, and sponsor text must be legible and correctly rendered — no blurred, distorted, or invented text

PERSON B — Pose:
- Standing upright in a natural celebratory posture, head slightly turned toward PERSON A or toward the crowd — NOT looking into the camera
- Expression: joyful, relaxed, emotionally present in the celebration moment
- Arms: naturally at sides or one slightly raised — complementing (not mirroring) PERSON A's extended arm
- Body language: reads as a teammate or companion sharing this celebration

Composition and scene:
- Both people stand on the same ground plane at the same depth and scale
- The background from Image 1 continues seamlessly: blurred maroon seating, scattered spectators, bright green horizontal LED band at bottom
- Camera angle: near eye-level with slight low telephoto perspective — same as Image 1
- Depth of field: both PERSON A and PERSON B equally sharp; background blurred

Lighting for PERSON B:
- Match Image 1 lighting exactly: bright stadium artificial lights, front-left/overhead direction
- Strong illumination on face and jersey, soft-to-moderate shadows
- Slightly cool-neutral color temperature with warm maroon/orange accent fill from crowd
- Cast shadows consistent with the same lighting source as PERSON A

Final quality constraints:
- The result must look like a single unedited professional sports photograph of two people
- No watermarks. No FOTOTARENA text. No seam lines. No floating artifacts
- No distorted faces, hands, logos, or sponsor text
- Both people firmly grounded on the pitch
- Photorealistic sports editorial quality — indistinguishable from a genuine dual-athlete photograph
